title: Bootstrapped B2B product
objective: Reach a repeatable growth position without prematurely scaling fixed costs.
must_show: Evidence created in product/customer work affects financing or distribution.
At least one bridge is probabilistic rather than guaranteed.
Plans remain coherent without the bridges.
At least two distinct architecture options.
common_failures: Treating investor funding as guaranteed by traction.
Calling all growth activities mutually reinforcing without mechanisms.

title: Service firm scaling
objective: Scale revenue while improving delivery reliability.
must_show: At least one loop with observable signals.
common_failures: Hiring based only on forecast without state evidence.

title: Research-to-implementation program
conditions: Organization wants a new internal standard
objective: Create an implementable standard without causing avoidable operational disruption.
must_show: Implementation readiness feeds back into design.
Research informs both design and implementation.
common_failures: Treating implementation as a simple last step.

title: Career portfolio under time constraint
conditions: Person wants to move into a new field
No direct work history in target field
objective: Increase competence and credible career options over six months.
must_show: Career discovery changes the learning agenda.

title: Manufacturing reliability
objective: Reduce defect rate without causing an uncontrolled production shortfall.

title: Nonprofit program expansion
objective: Expand reach while preserving program quality.
must_show: Evidence affects both funding and partnership design.
Partner delivery generates new operational information.
common_failures: Expansion treated as only a fundraising problem.

title: Data platform migration
conditions: Many internal teams depend on old interfaces
objective: Migrate safely while reducing long-term operational burden.
must_show: Observability creates risk-reduction states for migration.
Early consumer migrations generate information for platform work.
common_failures: Treating documentation as sufficient evidence of readiness.

title: Public launch with uncertain demand
conditions: Press interest is possible but not assured
objective: Launch while limiting inventory and support risk.
must_show: Communications are modeled as creating exposure, not guaranteed coverage.
common_failures: Maximizing launch attention without support constraints.
